title: SONIC-O1: A Real-World Benchmark for Evaluating Multimodal Large Language Models on Audio-Video Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2601.21666v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are a major focus of recent AI research. However, most prior work focuses on static image understanding, while their ability to process sequential audio-video data remains underexplored. This gap highlights the need for a high-quality benchmark to systematically evaluate MLLM performance in a real-world setting. We introduce SONIC-O1, a comprehensive, fully human-verified benchmark of 60 hours (231 clips) spanning 13 real-world conversational domains with 4,958 annotations and demographic metadata. SONIC-O1 evaluates three capabilities: open-ended summarization, multiple-choice question (MCQ) answering, and temporal localization with supporting rationales (reasoning). Across closed- and open-source models, we find that the MCQ accuracy shows the smallest gap between model families, but the best closed-source model outperforms the best open-source model by 22.6% on temporal localization. translated_title: SONIC-O1：一个用于评估多模态大语言模型音视频理解能力的真实世界基准测试
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）是近期AI研究的主要焦点。然而，大多数先前的工作集中于静态图像理解，而其处理顺序性音视频数据的能力仍未得到充分探索。这一差距凸显了对高质量基准测试的需求，以系统性地评估MLLM在真实世界环境中的性能。我们推出了SONIC-O1，这是一个全面的、完全经人工验证的基准测试，包含60小时（231个片段）的内容，涵盖13个真实世界对话领域，共有4,958条标注和人口统计元数据。SONIC-O1评估三种能力：开放式摘要、多选题（MCQ）回答以及带有支持性理由的时间定位（推理）。在闭源和开源模型中，我们发现MCQ准确率在模型家族之间差距最小，但最佳闭源模型在时间定位任务上比最佳开源模型高出22.6%。
tldr: 该论文提出了SONIC-O1——一个包含60小时真实世界音视频内容、覆盖13个对话领域且完全经人工验证的基准测试，用于评估多模态大语言模型在开放式摘要、多选题回答和时间定位推理上的能力，并揭示出最佳闭源模型在时间定位上领先最佳开源模型22.6%。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SONIC-O1, a fully human-verified benchmark comprising 60 hours of real-world audio-video content across 13 conversational domains that evaluates MLLMs on open-ended summarization, MCQ answering, and temporal localization with reasoning, revealing a 22.6% performance gap favoring the best closed-source model over the best open-source model on temporal localization.
